illustration.en: Cell counts illustrate axes, not model sizes; tint identifies roles, not numeric values.
illustration.zh: 格子数示意轴结构，而非模型规模；色阶区分语义角色，不表示数值。

flow.title.en: MetisCraft: from a question to a typed probability

flow.input.zh: Record 批次\\材料、问题、候选

flow.token.zh: 答案 token\\末位置与答案 ID

flow.scalar.zh: 标量头\\list 槽位／pairs 行

flow.axes.en: $B$: questions; $T$: tokens; $d$: hidden channels; $K$: padded candidate columns. $A$ masks padding; $M^{cand}$ marks valid candidates.
flow.axes.zh: $B$：问题数；$T$：token 数；$d$：隐藏维度；$K$：补齐的候选列数。$A$ 标记填充；$M^{cand}$ 标记有效候选。

flow.meaning.en: Both implemented readouts produce real scores $S$. Temperature routing is shared by offline and HTTP paths; HTTP supports noul, choice and score, while Record prediction also supports multi\_label.
flow.meaning.zh: 两类已实现读出都产生实数分数 $S$。离线与 HTTP 共享温度路由；HTTP 支持 noul、choice、score，Record 预测另支持 multi\_label。

token.stage1.zh: 因果编码与末位置选择

token.stage2.en: Vocabulary projection, then ordered answer-token selection
token.stage2.zh: 词表投影，再按顺序选择答案 token

token.axes.en: $B$: questions; $T$: tokens; $d$: hidden channels; $V$: vocabulary; $L$: answer-token IDs. $W_{\mathrm{lm}}$ is stored as $[V,d]$.
token.axes.zh: $B$：问题数；$T$：token 数；$d$：隐藏维度；$V$：词表；$L$：答案 token 数。$W_{\mathrm{lm}}$ 按 $[V,d]$ 存储。

token.meaning.en: The readout position sees all preceding options. Choice and score normalize over selected answer tokens, not the full vocabulary. For noul, the implementation uses $z_{yes}-z_{no}$ followed by sigmoid.
token.meaning.zh: 读出位置能看见前面的全部候选。choice 与 score 在所选答案 token 上归一化，而非整个词表；noul 使用 $z_{yes}-z_{no}$ 再做 sigmoid。

list.stage1.en: Default scalar layout: all candidates share one causal sequence
list.stage1.zh: 默认标量布局：候选共享同一条因果序列

list.stage2.en: Gather candidate slots; apply the same scalar head at every slot
list.stage2.zh: 选取候选槽位；各槽位使用同一个标量头

list.axes.en: $P_{b,k}\in\{0,\ldots,T-1\}$ selects a candidate's slot after left padding. $h_{b,k}=H_{b,P_{b,k},:}$ has shape $[d]$.
list.axes.zh: $P_{b,k}\in\{0,\ldots,T-1\}$ 是左填充后的候选槽位索引。$h_{b,k}=H_{b,P_{b,k},:}$ 的形状为 $[d]$。

list.meaning.en: Later candidates can attend to earlier candidates under the causal mask. An independent sigmoid output does not make their hidden representations independent. List is the current default; tree packing is not implemented.
list.meaning.zh: 因果 mask 允许后面的候选关注前面的候选。输出使用独立 sigmoid，并不意味着隐藏表示互相独立。list 是当前默认布局；未实现 tree 打包。

pairs.stage1.en: One independent sequence per valid question--candidate pair
pairs.stage1.zh: 每个有效问题—候选对独立成行

pairs.stage2.en: Score each row, then scatter back to question and candidate indices
pairs.stage2.zh: 逐行打分，再按问题与候选索引回填

pairs.axes.en: $R=\sum_b K_b$ counts valid pairs; $R=BK$ only when all questions have the same $K$. Rows are batchable, rather than $K$ obligatory serial model calls.
pairs.axes.zh: $R=\sum_b K_b$ 是有效候选对数；所有问题的候选数相同时才有 $R=BK$。这些行可以组成批次，不要求串行调用模型 $K$ 次。

pairs.meaning.en: A row contains the shared state/question and one candidate. Rows do not exchange hidden states. Softmax still couples the final probabilities within a question; runtime depends on batching, lengths and hardware.
pairs.meaning.zh: 每行包含同一材料／问题与一个候选，不同行不交换隐藏状态。softmax 仍会在问题内耦合最终概率；耗时取决于批量、长度和硬件。

notation.stage1.en: Discrete inputs: token IDs, padding support and candidate indexing
notation.stage1.zh: 离散输入：token ID、填充有效性与候选索引

notation.masks.en: Attention support is distinct from padding and candidate support
notation.masks.zh: 注意力可见性、填充有效性与候选有效性分别定义

notation.stage2.en: Tensor geometry follows the final two axes; transposition exchanges their edges
notation.stage2.zh: 矩阵正面对应末两轴；转置交换两条边

notation.support.en: $M^{attn}_{ij}=1\iff j\leq i$\\row = query, column = key\\filled = visible; blank = masked
notation.support.zh: $M^{attn}_{ij}=1\iff j\leq i$\\行是 query，列是 key\\实色表示可见；留白表示屏蔽

notation.axes.en: $B$: questions; $T$: tokens; $d$: hidden channels; $V$: vocabulary; $K$: candidate columns; $L$: answer IDs; $R=\sum_b K_b$: pair rows. $C$: packed sequences; $Q$: questions per packed sequence.
notation.axes.zh: $B$：问题；$T$：token；$d$：隐藏维度；$V$：词表；$K$：候选列；$L$：答案 ID；$R=\sum_b K_b$：pairs 行。$C$：打包序列；$Q$：每条打包序列的问题数。

notation.meaning.en: A matrix face shows its last two axes; offset sheets indicate leading batch axes. Vectors are drawn as columns. Binary support diagrams show exact illustrative support. $\tau$ is temperature; $T$ remains sequence length.
notation.meaning.zh: 矩阵正面表示末两轴；错位薄片表示前导批次轴；向量画成列。二值 mask 展示精确的示意可见性。$\tau$ 表示温度；$T$ 始终表示序列长度。

slot.stage1.en: Initialize a separate slot head from selected language-model head rows
slot.stage1.zh: 从语言模型头的指定行初始化独立槽位头

slot.stage2.en: Project into a fixed set of output slots
slot.stage2.zh: 投影到固定数量的输出槽位

slot.select.zh: 选取 token 行\\有序 ID $\ell$

slot.train.zh: 独立参数\\训练中可以更新

slot.axes.en: $W_{lm}:[V,d]$; $W_{slot}:[K,d]$; $h:[B,d]$. $K$ is the configured slot capacity. Initialization copies content, not a live link to the original rows.
slot.axes.zh: $W_{lm}:[V,d]$；$W_{slot}:[K,d]$；$h:[B,d]$。$K$ 是配置的槽位容量；初始化复制参数值，不保留与原始行的动态绑定。

slot.meaning.en: This comparison family changes the output parameterization. Attention visibility is a separate design choice: causal or bidirectional variants must be checked per implementation. A standard causal decoder is not automatically equivalent to a modified mask.
slot.meaning.zh: 此对照类别改变输出参数化方式。因果或双向注意力是另一项设计选择，需按具体实现核查；普通因果 decoder 不自动等价于修改了注意力 mask 的模型。

pointer.stage1.en: Gather one decision representation for each question in packed inputs
pointer.stage1.zh: 从打包输入中选取各问题的 decision 表示

pointer.stage2.en: Project candidate representations and score them against the decision query
pointer.stage2.zh: 投影候选表示，与 decision query 计算分数

pointer.gather.zh: 选取标记位置\\decision／选项末端

pointer.axes.en: $C$: input sequences; $Q$: questions per sequence; $B=CQ$ in the fixed-size example. $h^{dec}:[B,d]$; $h^{opt}:[B,K,d]$; $d_p$: pointer width.
pointer.axes.zh: $C$：输入序列数；$Q$：每序列问题数；等长示例中 $B=CQ$。$h^{dec}:[B,d]$；$h^{opt}:[B,K,d]$；$d_p$：pointer 维度。

pointer.meaning.en: This is a comparison architecture, not a MetisCraft readout. Branch visibility, option isolation and position IDs belong to its packing contract. Multiple questions per sequence do not imply a universal latency improvement; hybrid backbones may need separate rows.
pointer.meaning.zh: 这是对照架构，并非 MetisCraft 已实现读出。分支可见性、候选隔离与 position ID 属于打包协议；单序列多问题不意味着普遍提速，混合主干可能需要改用独立行。

joint.stage1.en: Build token memory and route evidence into candidate representations
joint.stage1.zh: 构造 token memory，并将证据路由到候选表示

joint.stage2.en: Aggregate each field, allow field interaction, then score field--candidate pairs
joint.stage2.zh: 汇总字段、建模字段交互，再对字段—候选对打分

joint.score.zh: 先验与门控打分\\余弦／成对 MLP

joint.axes.en: $H:[C,T,d]$; $Mem:[C,T,w]$; $O:[C,Q,K,w]$; $F:[C,Q,w]$; $B=CQ$ in the fixed-size example. Leading $C,Q$ axes flatten before reporting $S:[B,K]$.
joint.axes.zh: $H:[C,T,d]$；$Mem:[C,T,w]$；$O:[C,Q,K,w]$；$F:[C,Q,w]$。等长示例中 $B=CQ$；输出前将前导 $C,Q$ 轴展平，得到 $S:[B,K]$。

joint.meaning.en: This comparison family adds structured interactions in the head. Candidates may affect each other through field aggregation even without candidate self-attention. Causal visibility in the backbone and visibility in the head must be analyzed separately.
joint.meaning.zh: 此对照类别在读出头中加入结构化交互。即使候选之间没有 self-attention，也可能通过字段汇总相互影响；主干的因果可见性与头部的信息可见性需分别分析。

encoder.stage1.en: Uni-encoder: encode labels and text together, then compare representations
encoder.stage1.zh: 同编码：联合编码标签与文本，再比较表示

encoder.stage2.en: Bi-encoder: independent encoders produce a matrix of pairwise scores
encoder.stage2.zh: 双塔编码：独立编码后得到成对分数矩阵

encoder.stage3.en: Cross-encoder: jointly encode each independent text--candidate pair
encoder.stage3.zh: 交叉编码：逐个联合编码独立的文本—候选对

encoder.pool.zh: 选取标签向量\\池化文本向量

encoder.compare.zh: 标签—文本打分\\每标签一个分数

encoder.cache.en: Label vectors cacheable\\when label encoding is fixed
encoder.cache.zh: 标签编码固定时\\可缓存标签向量

encoder.axes.en: $U:[B,d]$ holds text vectors; label vectors have shape $E:[B,K,d]$ (uni) or $[K,d]$ (bi). $R=\sum_b K_b$ counts cross-encoder rows; $\tau$ is score temperature.
encoder.axes.zh: $U:[B,d]$ 为文本向量；标签向量 $E$ 在同编码中为 $[B,K,d]$，双塔中为 $[K,d]$。$R=\sum_b K_b$ 为交叉编码行数；$\tau$ 是打分温度。

encoder.meaning.en: Visibility depends on the layout. Uni-encoders permit label interaction; bi-encoders separate label encoding; cross-encoders expose text and one candidate to each other. There is no hardware-independent latency or accuracy ordering.
encoder.meaning.zh: 信息可见性取决于布局：同编码允许标签交互；双塔独立编码标签；交叉编码让文本与单个候选相互可见。三者没有脱离硬件和任务的固定延迟或准确率排序。

generated.stage1.en: Generate rationale tokens with autoregressive dependencies
generated.stage1.zh: 以自回归方式生成理由 token

generated.stage2.en: Read answer-token probabilities after the generated rationale
generated.stage2.zh: 在生成的理由之后读出答案 token 概率

generated.decode.zh: 自回归解码\\$G$ 个理由 token

generated.token.zh: 末位置隐藏表示投影\\选择答案 ID

generated.axes.en: $G$: generated rationale length; $T$: total length after concatenation; $K$: answer choices. The final vocabulary selection has the same shape as answer-token readout.
generated.axes.zh: $G$：生成理由的长度；$T$：拼接后的总长度；$K$：答案候选数。最终词表选择的形状与答案 token 读出相同。

generated.meaning.en: This is a comparison, not an implemented MetisCraft fallback. Rationale tokens add serial decoding dependencies; cache reuse, batching and the final readout determine actual model invocations. Sampling can change the resulting distribution.
generated.meaning.zh: 这是对照方法，并非 MetisCraft 已实现的兜底路径。理由 token 引入串行解码依赖；实际调用次数取决于缓存复用、批量与最终读出方式，采样也会改变最终分布。

contract.stage1.en: System One public interface: an observable request--response contract
contract.stage1.zh: System One 公共接口：可观察的请求—响应协议

contract.stage2.en: MetisCraft realization: explicit scores and task-aware probability transforms
contract.stage2.zh: MetisCraft 实现：显式分数与按任务选择的概率变换

contract.state.zh: 请求\\材料与类型化问题

contract.normalize.zh: 先验修正与温度\\有效候选与归一化

contract.output.en: Record score: argmax level\\HTTP score: expected level\\score confidence: max probability
contract.output.zh: Record score：argmax 等级\\HTTP score：期望等级\\score confidence：最大概率

contract.axes.en: $B$ counts atomic questions, not requests. $K$ is padded candidate capacity; noul has a single positive logit. $p:[B,K]$ is an internal unifying view, not a claim about private System One tensors.
contract.axes.zh: $B$ 计数原子问题，而非 HTTP 请求；$K$ 是补齐后的候选容量，noul 使用单个正类 logit。$p:[B,K]$ 是统一的内部表示，不描述 System One 私有张量。

contract.meaning.en: Public outputs specify behavior, not proprietary architecture. MetisCraft implements four Record types, including multi\_label; its current HTTP protocol exposes three types. A probability is confidence assigned by the model, not a correctness guarantee.
contract.meaning.zh: 公共输出约束行为，不披露私有架构。MetisCraft 的 Record 支持含 multi\_label 在内的四类判断；当前 HTTP 协议支持三类。概率表示模型赋予的置信程度，不是正确性保证。

training.stage1.en: Train only on the training split; aggregate per-question losses
training.stage1.zh: 训练仅使用训练集；按问题汇总损失

training.stage2.en: Completion training: two target positions retain the full vocabulary axis
training.stage2.zh: Completion 训练：两个目标位置保留完整词表轴

training.stage3.en: Fit temperature on independent calibration data; apply the same transform in serving
training.stage3.zh: 独立校准集拟合温度；推理时复用同一变换

training.update.zh: 梯度累积\\按问题数归一化

training.split.zh: 更新可训练参数\\封存模型产物

training.completion.zh: 完整词表 CE\\code 与 EOS 损失取均值

training.temperature.zh: 校准温度\\按任务／类型选择 $\tau>0$

training.axes.en: $Z_{completion}:[B,2,V]$; targets $y:[B,2]$ contain answer code and EOS. $N$ is the number of questions contributing to an optimizer update. $\Delta$ is the configured prior offset; $\tau$ is temperature.
training.axes.zh: $Z_{completion}:[B,2,V]$；目标 $y:[B,2]$ 包含答案 code 与 EOS。$N$ 是一次优化器更新累计的问题数；$\Delta$ 为配置的先验偏移；$\tau$ 为温度。

training.meaning.en: Training, calibration and evaluation splits have separate purposes. Calibration optimizes a probability objective, not necessarily accuracy, and can worsen held-out NLL. Offline and HTTP use the same task/kind routing and recorded fallback decisions.
training.meaning.zh: 训练、校准与评测划分各有用途。校准优化概率目标，不保证准确率提高，也可能使独立评测 NLL 变差。离线与 HTTP 复用任务／类型路由，并记录回退决策。

overview.stage1.en: Output parameterization: vocabulary tokens, fixed slots or candidate scalar scores
overview.stage1.zh: 输出参数化：词表 token、固定槽位或候选标量

overview.stage2.en: Structured or encoder alternatives: score operators and information flow differ
overview.stage2.zh: 结构化与 encoder 对照：打分算子和信息流不同

overview.stage3.en: Execution and scope: distinguish a comparison family from a shipped implementation
overview.stage3.zh: 执行与边界：区分对照类别与已经交付的实现

overview.token.zh: 1. 答案 token logits\\$[B,V]\to[B,L]$\\选取指定词表 ID

overview.slot.en: 2. Fixed slot head\\$[B,d]\,[d,K]\to[B,K]$\\copy token rows at initialization
overview.slot.zh: 2. 固定槽位头\\$[B,d]\,[d,K]\to[B,K]$\\初始化时复制 token 行

overview.scalar.zh: 3. 候选标量头\\$[R,d]\to[R]\to[B,K]$\\独立 pairs 行

overview.pointer.zh: 4. Pointer 头\\$q:[B,d_p],\ k:[B,K,d_p]$\\decision 与候选点积

overview.joint.en: 5. Joint schema head\\$O:[C,Q,K,w],\ F:[C,Q,w]$\\evidence routing + field interaction
overview.joint.zh: 5. 联合 schema 头\\$O:[C,Q,K,w],\ F:[C,Q,w]$\\证据路由与字段交互

overview.encoder.en: 6. Encoder scoring\\uni / bi / cross layouts\\visibility depends on the layout
overview.encoder.zh: 6. Encoder 打分\\同编码／双塔／交叉编码\\可见性取决于布局

overview.generated.en: 7. Generate then read\\rationale + answer-token readout\\serial decoding dependencies
overview.generated.zh: 7. 生成后读出\\理由生成与答案 token 读出\\引入串行解码依赖

overview.list.en: MetisCraft scalar default: list\\$[B,K,d]\to[B,K]$\\shared causal sequence
overview.list.zh: MetisCraft 标量默认：list\\$[B,K,d]\to[B,K]$\\共享同一因果序列

overview.scope.en: Implemented: answer tokens + scalar\\tree packing: not implemented\\no universal speed ranking
overview.scope.zh: 已实现：答案 token 与标量头\\tree 打包：尚未实现\\不存在普遍的速度排序

overview.axes.en: $B$: questions; $R=\sum_b K_b$: independent candidate rows; $C$: packed sequences; $Q$: questions per sequence; $K$: candidate capacity; $L$: answer-token count. Dots indicate operations, not benchmark results.
overview.axes.zh: $B$：问题数；$R=\sum_b K_b$：独立候选行；$C$：打包序列；$Q$：每序列问题数；$K$：候选容量；$L$：答案 token 数。算子关系不表示性能测试结果。

overview.meaning.en: The seven families compare mechanisms; they are not seven supported MetisCraft backends. The shipped toolkit implements answer-token and candidate-scalar readouts, with list and pairs layouts for the latter. Accuracy and latency require matched measurements.
overview.meaning.zh: 七类用于比较机制，并非 MetisCraft 支持七个后端。当前工具包实现答案 token 与候选标量两类读出，后者包含 list 和 pairs 布局。准确率与延迟需在一致协议下实测。

flow.token.title.en: Answer-token branch: noul, choice and score
flow.token.title.zh: 答案 token 分支：noul、choice 与 score

flow.scalar.title.en: Candidate-scalar branch: all four Record judgment types
flow.scalar.title.zh: 候选标量分支：全部四种 Record 判断类型
